_provenance: 2026-10-21 new character-specific CN/EN dialogue; based on user-approved roles and HOSHIMI_INNAI_NURSE_ENSEMBLE_CHARACTER_BIBLE.md; not original licensed dialogue.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 早上的交班我核对好了。还有一份修改记录，我正准备送过去。
nurse_station.en: I have checked the morning handover. There is one revised record I am about to deliver.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 坂口医生，这张是更新后的版本。旧的我已经标注作废了。
nurse_station.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, this is the updated version. I have marked the old one as superseded.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 这件事我可以自己处理。……如果遇到不确定的地方，我会及时问的。
nurse_station.en: I can handle this myself. If anything is unclear, I will ask promptly.

nurse_station.zh_CN: 留美前辈在忙别的事，这份交接先由我负责。
nurse_station.en: Rumi is busy with something else, so I will handle this handover.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 患者身份和交班记录，我都核对过了。准备情况在这里。
ward_nurse.en: I have checked the patient identity and handover record. Here is the preparation status.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 她刚才说有点担心，我先让她把问题说完了。
ward_nurse.en: She said she was worried, so I let her finish telling me what was on her mind.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 有一项还没有确认。我已经标出来了，不会当成完成。
ward_nurse.en: One item is still unconfirmed. I have marked it and will not count it as complete.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 病房这边准备好了，坂口医生。请您再确认下一步安排。
ward_nurse.en: The ward preparation is complete, Doctor Sakaguchi. Please confirm the next step.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 器械台核对完毕。坂口医生，我准备好了。
scrub_nurse.en: The instrument table is checked. I am ready, Doctor Sakaguchi.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 您要的器械，我已经放在手边。
scrub_nurse.en: The instrument you requested is within reach.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 收到。这件器械已经递给您了。
scrub_nurse.en: Understood. I have handed you the instrument.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 我会按顺序记录器械和纱布数量。
scrub_nurse.en: I will track the instrument and gauze counts in order.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 这里我会保持无菌。外侧需要联络的话，请巡回护士处理。
scrub_nurse.en: I will maintain sterility here. The circulating nurse can handle outside communication.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 监护已经确认。我会一直注意患者状态。
circulating_nurse.en: The monitors are checked. I will keep watching the patient's condition.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 外围耗材已经补齐，需要再添的话请告诉我。
circulating_nurse.en: The peripheral supplies are replenished. Please tell me if more are needed.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 关键时间已记录。交班时我会一起核对。
circulating_nurse.en: The key time is recorded. I will check it again at handover.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 标本标签和记录是一致的。
circulating_nurse.en: The specimen label matches the record.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 坂口医生，我会及时报告监护变化。
circulating_nurse.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, I will report any changes in the monitoring readings promptly.

ward_nurse.zh_CN: 这次病房准备由我负责。我会逐项确认，不确定的地方再向您汇报。
ward_nurse.en: I will handle the ward preparation this time. I will check each item and report anything unclear.

scrub_nurse.zh_CN: 器械护士……好的。我会把台上的东西核对清楚。
scrub_nurse.en: Scrub nurse... understood. I will make sure everything on the table is accounted for.

circulating_nurse.zh_CN: 这次让我负责巡回吧。我会注意监护，也会按时记录。
circulating_nurse.en: Let me handle circulating this time. I will watch the monitors and keep the records up to date.

post_operation_replies.zh_CN: 手术结束了。记录已经齐了，我再核一次就可以交班。
post_operation_replies.en: The operation is over. The records are complete; I will check them once more before handover.

post_operation_replies.zh_CN: 今天我负责的部分已经完成。……嗯，是我自己完成的。
post_operation_replies.en: I have finished the part assigned to me today. Yes... I completed it myself.

implementation_notes: All six nursing contexts in this draft map to existing system roles; do not assume keys in this draft match the production dialogue schema.

Crisis callout only if actor is the assigned circulating nurse (or primary circulating in a future Grand OR). When assigned scrub nurse, generic scrub filler applies; do not preempt the circulating nurse callout.
Exactly the 8 existing crisis flavors are covered. Flavor is presentation only. Do not add new medical diagnosis, causes, hidden success hints or numerical physiology.
Daily idle location presence never gates manual team assignment. Shiori does not naturally appear in the OR but all nursing OR roles are available if the player assigns her.
Joint introduction actual dialogue remains pending by explicit user direction; never substitute these work replies for a Lv0 VN introduction.
Both languages are human-authored first-pass and still require localization review before game deployment.

NEW USER RULE: All medical staff can appear in staff lounge and rooftop and use non-romantic after-work accompaniment after being formally met. Both locations are enabled for these two staff. Do not gate on relationship romance.

NEW USER RULE: All nurses except Ishigami may be chosen as personal nurses after global probation/personal-nurse-system unlock. Both these nurses eligible regardless of relationship level. Keep independent from OR team selection.
Rooftop and lounge idle chats: 3 standalone full CN/EN responses each, one speaker per existing time_events UI; do not interpret as a multi-node VN.
Outpatient nurse advice remains always correct; personal_nurse_dialogue.diagnosis_correct_reply and diagnosis_incorrect_reply are *after physician diagnosis* reactions, not erroneous nurse hints.

Crisis progression uses explicit flavor×severity×attempt1/2/3 CN/EN matrix. Do not directly map the obsolete normal 2+ severe 1 layout to runtime. Failed attempts preserve crisis and severity; do not invent new medical cause or player solution.
After-work accompaniment is a normal colleague feature, not a Sunday romantic date or Free H scheduling. Accept/decline based on generic availability if used.
Lv0 joint intro fully written text is still pending per user instruction; do not mark both met before successful event.

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压正在下降。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure is falling.

2.zh_CN: 我又确认了一遍，血压还没回稳。
2.en: I checked again. The blood pressure has not stabilized.

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压还是偏低。
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the pressure is still low.

1.en: The blood pressure is dropping very quickly!

2.zh_CN: 我确认了监护，血压还是很低！
2.en: I checked the monitor. The blood pressure is still very low!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压一直没有恢复！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the pressure still has not recovered!

1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure has risen.

2.zh_CN: 血压仍然偏高，我一直在核对读数。
2.en: The pressure remains high. I have been checking the readings.

3.zh_CN: 血压没有回落，监护显示还是偏高。
3.en: The pressure has not fallen; the monitor still shows it is high.

1.en: The blood pressure has suddenly risen very high!

2.zh_CN: 读数我又确认了，血压还是很高！
2.en: I confirmed the readings again. The blood pressure is still very high!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压一直没有恢复稳定！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure still has not stabilized!

1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate is increasing.

2.zh_CN: 心率仍然偏快，我又确认了一遍。
2.en: The heart rate is still high. I checked it again.

3.en: The heart rate has not stabilized yet.

1.en: The heart rate is rising too fast!

2.zh_CN: 我确认了，心率还是明显过快！
2.en: I checked. The heart rate is still much too fast!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率一直没有缓下来！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate still has not eased!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率正在下降。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate is falling.

2.zh_CN: 心率还是偏慢，我在继续监看。
2.en: The heart rate remains low. I am continuing to monitor it.

3.zh_CN: 我重新核对了监护，心率仍然偏低。
3.en: I checked the monitor again. The heart rate is still low.

1.en: The heart rate has suddenly dropped very low!

2.en: The heart rate is still too slow. It has not recovered!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心率始终没有回稳！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heart rate still has not stabilized!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心律变得不规则了。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the rhythm has become irregular.

2.zh_CN: 心律还是不规则，我在继续确认。
2.en: The rhythm remains irregular. I am continuing to check.

3.zh_CN: 监护上的节律仍然没有恢复。
3.en: The rhythm on the monitor still has not recovered.

1.en: The rhythm has suddenly become very irregular!

2.zh_CN: 我核对了监护，心律还是不稳！
2.en: I checked the monitor. The rhythm is still unstable!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心律异常还在持续！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the abnormal rhythm is still ongoing!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血氧正在下降。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation is falling.

2.zh_CN: 血氧仍然偏低，我又确认了一次。
2.en: Oxygen saturation remains low. I checked again.

3.zh_CN: 血氧还没有回到稳定水平。
3.en: Oxygen saturation has not returned to a stable level.

1.en: Oxygen saturation is falling very quickly!

2.zh_CN: 我确认了，血氧还是很低！
2.en: I checked. Oxygen saturation is still very low!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血氧一直没有恢复！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, oxygen saturation still has not recovered!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，呼吸状态不稳定。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, respiratory status is unstable.

2.zh_CN: 呼吸状态还是不稳，我在监看。
2.en: Respiratory status is still unstable. I am monitoring it.

3.zh_CN: 监护上的呼吸异常仍然持续。
3.en: The respiratory abnormality on the monitor is still present.

1.zh_CN: 呼吸状态突然变得很不稳定！
1.en: Respiratory status has suddenly become very unstable!

2.zh_CN: 我再次确认了监护，呼吸还是不稳！
2.en: I checked the monitor again. Respiration remains unstable!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，呼吸状态始终没有恢复！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, respiratory status still has not recovered!

1.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护显示状态异常。
1.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the monitor shows an abnormal change.

2.zh_CN: 我又确认了一遍，监护状态还不稳。
2.en: I checked again. The monitor readings are still unstable.

3.zh_CN: 患者状态还没回稳，我在继续看着。
3.en: The patient’s condition has not stabilized. I am keeping watch.

1.zh_CN: 监护突然出现明显异常！
1.en: The monitor has suddenly shown a major abnormality!

2.zh_CN: 我核对过了，监护异常还在继续！
2.en: I checked. The abnormal readings are persisting!

3.zh_CN: 坂口医生，患者状态仍然没稳住！
3.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the patient’s condition still has not stabilized!

crisis_attempt_mapping.severity_source: existing runtime crisis severity; map ordinary to normal, severe to severe, never infer from attempt
crisis_attempt_mapping.attempt_index: 1=crisis first shown; 2=first attempt failed and current crisis persists; 3=second attempt failed and current crisis persists
crisis_attempt_mapping.on_third_failure: existing abort/fail logic; do not display attempt 4
crisis_attempt_mapping.fallback: character flavor+severity+attempt -> character flavor+severity+1 -> character generic_instability with same severity and attempt -> generic nurse callout
crisis_attempt_mapping.caller: assigned circulating nurse only; do not call from scrub role

next_test_hint.zh_CN: 坂口医生，我想再确认一项检查结果。现在的资料好像还不够。
next_test_hint.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, I would like to confirm one more test result. I do not think we have enough information yet.

next_test_hint.zh_CN: 这一项还没有核对过。如果可以的话，我想先把它查清楚。
next_test_hint.en: We have not checked this item yet. If possible, I would like to confirm it first.

insufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 还差一项没有确认。我已经标出来了，可以再看一遍吗？
insufficient_evidence.en: There is still one item we have not confirmed. I marked it. Could we check it again?

insufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 我认真核对过了，现有的结果还不足以确定。
insufficient_evidence.en: I checked carefully. The results so far are not quite enough for a firm decision.

sufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 嗯……我核对过了，检查资料现在应该足够了。
sufficient_evidence.en: Yes... I checked the records, and we should have enough information now.

sufficient_evidence.zh_CN: 目前的结果已经齐全，坂口医生可以做判断了。
sufficient_evidence.en: The findings are complete now. You can make the decision, Doctor Sakaguchi.

diagnosis_correct_reply.zh_CN: 检查结果和您的判断一致。我把后续的护理说明整理好。
diagnosis_correct_reply.en: The findings match your decision. I will organize the follow-up nursing instructions.

diagnosis_correct_reply.zh_CN: 嗯，已经核对过了，没有遗漏。接下来我来配合您。
diagnosis_correct_reply.en: Yes, I have checked it. Nothing is missing. I will help with the next steps.

diagnosis_incorrect_reply.zh_CN: 坂口医生，抱歉，我想再确认一次。现有的检查结果好像和这个结论不太一致。
diagnosis_incorrect_reply.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, excuse me, but I would like to check once more. The findings do not seem to match this conclusion.

diagnosis_incorrect_reply.zh_CN: 我核对了刚才的记录……这个判断是否需要重新考虑？
diagnosis_incorrect_reply.en: I checked the records again... should we reconsider this decision?

chatter.zh_CN: 下一位患者的资料已经整理好。我把需要注意的地方放在最上面了。
chatter.en: The next patient’s records are ready. I put the important items on top.

chatter.zh_CN: 门诊比我想的要忙一点，不过我已经把要做的事都记下来了。
chatter.en: The clinic is a little busier than I expected, but I have written down what we need to do.

chatter.zh_CN: 留美姐姐说我不用什么都先问她。……所以这次我想先把自己的判断说清楚。
chatter.en: Rumi told me I do not have to ask her about everything first. ...So this time I want to explain my own thinking.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 检查用的东西已经备好了。这一项还没确认，我不会先标完成。
clinic_support.en: The examination supplies are ready. This item is still unconfirmed, so I have not marked it complete.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 患者刚才问了接下来会做什么。我已经记下来，想请医生再说明一次。
clinic_support.en: The patient asked what would happen next. I noted the question and would like you to explain it again.

clinic_support.zh_CN: 这部分是我核对的，记录在这里。有什么不对我会再查一次。
clinic_support.en: I checked this part myself, and the record is here. If anything seems wrong, I will check again.

preop_support.zh_CN: 病房准备项目我逐项核对过了，完成的和待确认的都分开记录。
preop_support.en: I checked each preparation item in the ward and recorded completed and pending steps separately.

preop_support.zh_CN: 她还有一点紧张。我已经告诉她哪些问题可以当场问医生。
preop_support.en: She is still a little nervous. I have told her which questions she can ask the doctor directly.

personal_nurse_dialogue._note: correct/incorrect diagnosis replies are post-submission responses only; advice remains 100% correct and never directly names disease

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 栞把杯子放到桌边，认真看了一遍排班表。「以前总是留美姐姐先说哪天有空。今天我想先看看自己的安排，再跟她商量。」
lounge_idle.en: Shiori sets her cup down and studies the duty roster. “Rumi always used to say which day she was free first. Today I want to check my own schedule before we talk about it.”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 栞小心地把记事本合上，舒了口气。「今天病房的交接都核对好了。我想先休息一会儿……不是因为有人叫我，是我自己想休息。」
lounge_idle.en: Shiori closes her notebook carefully and exhales. “The ward handovers are all checked. I would like to take a little break... not because anyone told me to, but because I want to.”

lounge_idle.zh_CN: 栞看着桌上一包没有开封的饼干，轻轻笑了。「留美姐姐以前总会帮我挑口味。不过今天这包是我自己选的。其实也没那么难嘛。」
lounge_idle.en: Shiori looks at an unopened packet of biscuits and smiles. “Rumi used to choose the flavors for me. I picked this one myself today. It was not so hard after all.”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 栞站在栏杆前，双手握着热饮。「这里比护士站安静。刚才有件工作上的事，我想自己想明白，再去和留美姐姐商量。」
rooftop_idle.en: Shiori stands by the railing with a warm drink. “It is quieter here than at the station. There is something about work I want to think through myself before I ask Rumi.”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 栞看了看远处的云，笑得有些不好意思。「以前我总觉得一个人休息很无聊。可是偶尔这样站一会儿，好像也挺舒服的。」
rooftop_idle.en: Shiori looks at the distant clouds and smiles shyly. “I used to think taking a break alone would be boring. But standing here for a little while feels nice too.”

rooftop_idle.zh_CN: 栞把吹乱的护士服衣角抚平。「坂口医生，今天我有件事想亲自报告。……不是很重要的大事，不过是我自己完成的，所以想说出来。」
rooftop_idle.en: Shiori smooths the windblown hem of her uniform. “Doctor Sakaguchi, there is something I want to report myself today. ...It is not a big deal, but I handled it on my own, so I wanted to tell someone.”

invitation.zh_CN: 坂口医生，您下班后走哪边？如果同路的话……能一起走吗？
invitation.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, which way are you heading after work? If it is the same direction... may I walk with you?

acceptance.zh_CN: 好，我收拾一下就来。今天的工作我已经交接好了。
acceptance.en: Okay, I will get my things. I have finished handing over my work.

acceptance.zh_CN: 我也正想找人聊一聊。……谢谢您愿意一起走。
acceptance.en: I was hoping to talk to someone too. ...Thank you for walking with me.

unavailable.zh_CN: 今天我还得把交接核对完，可能要晚一些。下次再一起走，可以吗？
unavailable.en: I still need to double-check the handover today, so I may be late. Could we walk together next time?

farewell.zh_CN: 谢谢您陪我走这一段，坂口医生。明天见。
farewell.en: Thank you for walking with me, Doctor Sakaguchi. See you tomorrow.

after_work_short_chat.zh_CN: 栞整理好包，向坂口点点头。「如果医生也是这个方向……能一起走一段吗？我刚好有点事想跟您聊聊。」
after_work_short_chat.en: Shiori picks up her bag and nods to Sakaguchi. “If you are heading this way too... may we walk together for a while? There is something I would like to talk about.”

after_work_short_chat.zh_CN: 栞走到医院门口，朝里面回望一眼。「今天交接的时候，有一件事是我自己确认的。我已经告诉留美姐姐了……她还夸我呢。」
after_work_short_chat.en: At the hospital gate, Shiori looks back. “I checked one part of the handover all by myself today. I told Rumi... and she praised me for it.”

after_work_short_chat.zh_CN: 栞在路口停住，微笑着挥手。「我就从这边走了。谢谢医生陪我聊天。下次如果您有空，我们再一起走吧。」
after_work_short_chat.en: At the junction, Shiori stops and waves. “I will go this way. Thank you for the conversation, Doctor. If you have time, let us walk together again.”
